text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Another day full of mistakes... Urgh... Siiiiigh.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, Doto, that was cool! You're sooo
good at
breathing out!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I-it was just a sigh... How could that be
anything
amazing?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
But that means you've got good lung
cuppa-city,
right?! The manga I'm
reading says that's super
important to
running!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: That's not it... I'm just breathing normally, see? Inhale... Exhale...

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Whoooa! You know, this actually feels
really
good! I can't believe you
discovered something so
cooool!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Wh-what? Ah, you're right... I feel a
little more...
relaxed?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Hehe... Urara, you really are such a
sweetheart.
